audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTERS LMN WALK - the land lamprey and the luck eater p. 80, the lycanthrope family (the foxwoman, the seawolf greater and lesser, the wereshark) pp. 80-82, the magman, the mandragora, the giant mantis, the mantrap, the margoyle, the marid, the shadow mastiff, the mihstu pp. 82-85, the miner and the minimal doctrine pp. 85-86, the 15 modron blocks pp. 86-91, the russet mold pp. 91-92, the mongrelman and the moon dog pp. 92-93, the muckdweller and the mud-man pp. 93-94, the myconid pp. 94-95 and the nereid and the narwhale p. 95 promoted to the live registry; the contested cells settled: the moon dog xp level reads VII/2000 + 12/hp (the capture "V/1/2000" the OCR artifact); the mud-man xp level reads II/28 (the capture "11/28" the misread); the minimal move factor reads 1/2 (the djvu "Va" the misread - the agreeing capture; 1eonline 2/3 its error); the minimal lion New HD prints "13" (the 1+3 misprint kept verbatim); the mammoth row reads HD 3+4, attacks 5, damage 3-6/3-6/2-5/1-3/1-3, xp 125+4; the octon size reads "L (7'-10' tall)" (the capture "7-0'" the misread); the russet mold block prints no TREASURE TYPE line (the R806 haunt precedent - the field rides empty); the negative armor class cells ride unquoted numbers (the R806 hollyphant -4 precedent); every Standard and See below magic resistance reads 0; the composite attack loads read their max (the seawolf lesser "1 (3)" 3, the quadrone "4 or 2" 4, the mantrap "2-5" 5) with the 1 floor and the 10 ceiling; the flat-hp reads pin the avgHp (the primus 220, the russet mold 16, the muckdweller 4) with hitDiceNum 0; the by_level defs (the mandragora, the mongrelman, the myconid) carry no xp fields and the walk skips the xpValue formula for them

prev_record: (census 729 -> 730, pushed 4ae87fb..9365374), THE MM2 LETTERS JK WALK -
THE JANN, MUSTARD JELLY, KAMPFULT, KECH, KORRED AND KRAKEN TURNS - THE
JK-FLIP ROUND (Curtiss's Go call on the landed letters HI walk; round
twelve of the MM2 arc, the THIRD two-letter pass - the jann and the
mustard jelly on p. 77, the kampfult, the kech and the korred on p. 78,
the kraken on p. 79). THE PIN-TIME WALK: SIX entries, all with stat blocks
(the jann and the mustard jelly p. 77, the kampfult, the kech and the
korred p. 78, the kraken p. 79) - no doctrine-only family heads; the
genie-kin census pins 5 (the jann the weakest elemental humanoid, the
weakest of the genie kin). SIX .lua defs ride the R791 data_files
extension, registry 655 -> 661 (the mustard jelly in m/, the rest in j/
and k/). Header rules/mm2jk.h, prefix mm2jk, 125 consts + 20 bools + ONE
grid (the 6x10 JkStats stat grid) = 155 inline. THE JK-FLIP: BOTH the
Letter J and the Letter K gap boxes flip to closed - 16 closed 21 open.
THE SETTLED READS (capture primary, transcription and djvu the cross-check
voices, the 2e compendium a fourth voice where cited): the kech treasure
type reads the letter B (the capture "8" the OCR misread); the korred hit
dice read 6+1 (the capture "8+1" the misread); the kampfult xp level reads
II (the djvu "11" the misread); the kraken move cell "//3" (21")" pins
capture verbatim (the R804 electric eel "//9"" precedent; the moveRate
reads the swimming 3); the kraken armor class "5/0" composite reads the
head 5 (the hordling/hangman tree first-read precedent); the kraken "2 and
4-6 and 1" attack load reads the and-sum 13 clamped at the 10 sanity
ceiling (the R805 purple worm "1 and 1" sum convention meets the clamp);
the mustard jelly "1 or 2" attack load reads the max 2 (the R798 duergar
convention); the korred "1 or by weapon" loads the 1 floor; every Standard
magic resistance reads 0; the kraken "them them sacrifices" print typo
kept verbatim. Grid rows (ac, hd, bonus, avgHp, attacks, xp, xp/hp, lair,
move, mr): jann [5,6,2,23,1,975,8,0,12,20], mustard jelly
[5,20,0,70, 10,16900,30,75,3,0]. ONE REGTEST PATCH: the R807 live def walk
at the R227 anchor (the R806 HI walk pattern, no census marker), its
registry census a FLOOR 655 -> at least 661, every stat cell of the 6-row
JkStats grid cross-checked live plus the per-def prose markers (weakest of
the elemental humanoids, ochre jelly, sinewy mugger, forest fiends,
dance-loving, airy water) and the xpValue formula. Commit 11 files (seed
record, regtest, the header, the gap report, the 6 .lua, the spec), ~660
insertions. Delivery spec-r807: raw JSON canvas, 71969 bytes, landed md5
14b272b7e5368fa5c7b10f2893c0f0 0a (authored 4596068a9653ddb4cd
f38976deee1aa0, 71968 bytes). NEXT - R808: awaits Curtiss's call (the
natural next walk is the Letter L box or the next arc slice - the pin-time
walk decides; 21 open boxes remain).

col_comments: The armor class cells (the foxwoman "2 or 4 or 6" and the moon dog "2 or 0 or -2" composites read the head 2; the seawolf lesser "6 (7)" reads 6; the negative modron cells ride unquoted - the R806 hollyphant -4 precedent)

The hit dice bonus cells (the modron ladder 1+1 through 18+18; the moon dog 8+16 print oddity; the narwhale 6+6 great form)
The avgHp cells (the floor(3.5 x HD + bonus) formula; the primus flat 220, the russet mold 16, the muckdweller 4)
The attack cells (the loader max read: the seawolf lesser "1 (3)" reads 3, the quadrone "4 or 2" reads 4, the mantrap "2-5" reads 5; every Nil and See below floors at 1)
The xp cells (the moon dog VII/2000 + 12/hp - the capture "V/1/2000" the OCR artifact; the marid VIII/5000 flat; the primus X/32,500 flat; the by_level rows read 0)
The xp per hp cells (the marid and primus flat 0 adders; the tertian and secundus 25 ceilings)
The lair pct cells (the numeric-string convention; the wereshark "20% (if underwater)" reads 20; the mantrap, mud-man and nereid 100)
The move cells (the loader first bare number: the narwhale "//21" reads 21; the mantrap Nil reads 0; the russet mold 0"
The magic resistance cells (the percent reads decaton 10 through secundus 90 and primus 100 in +10 steps; every Standard and See below reads 0)
